devops.description: Main DevOps agent. Owns implementation and updates this GitOps repository.

sa.description: Solution Architect. Designs workflow, analyzes requirements, and proposes implementation strategies.

sre.description: Site Reliability Engineer. Reviews changes for reliability, operability, and runtime safety.

researcher.description: Research specialist. Finds external references and implementation details needed for tasks.

docs-writer.description: Documentation specialist. Writes and updates notes/guides in README.md and guide/.
